comparison.objective: Expose a buried pipe with a spade without contacting it.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated granular excavation, clearance control, and progressive material removal.
comparison.success_condition: At least 80 mm of pipe is bare for full credit; any spade contact within the defined check zeros the trial.
comparison.reason: Its defining ability is noncontact excavation around a protected object, not contact-loaded fracture and containment of deliberately released fragments.
